summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model hubs that host and distribute weights and developer-facing inference APIs that serve those models at scale. Hugging Face anchors the space as the dominant repository, having crossed 3 million public models in August 2026, though downloads are highly concentrated—roughly the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads. Alongside it, platforms like Ollama (local inference), Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow provide hosted or local serving options optimized for speed, cost, and ease of deployment.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository and community hub for hosting, sharing, and discovering AI models, datasets, and demos, with optional hosted inference.
platforms.pricing: Free hosting and public repos; Pro ~$9/mo; Inference Endpoints and serverless Inference priced per compute/usage; Enterprise plans available
features: Largest open model and dataset hub
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open-source libraries
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Model cards, versioning, and git-based repos
Download stats and query-file-based download counting
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML developers, and teams needing the broadest selection of open models, datasets, and tooling

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A tool for running open-weight LLMs locally on personal machines and servers with a simple CLI and API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; runs on local hardware so no API costs
features: One-command model pulls and runs locally
Quantized GGUF models for consumer hardware
Local REST API compatible with OpenAI format
Modelfile customization for prompts and parameters
platforms.best_for: Developers and hobbyists wanting private, local, offline model inference without cloud costs

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform to run and deploy open-source and custom models via a simple API, with easy packaging via Cog.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community-published models across modalities (image, video, audio, text)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by inference time/compute (per-second hardware pricing); no subscription required
features: Run models with a single API call
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Strong catalog of image/video/audio generation models
platforms.best_for: App developers who want to integrate generative AI (especially media models) without managing infrastructure

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A developer inference and fine-tuning cloud offering fast, low-cost serving of open-source LLMs plus GPU clusters.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (varies by model size); dedicated endpoints and GPU cluster rental; fine-tuning priced per token/job
features: Dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters for training
Broad catalog of chat, code, image, and embedding models
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups building production LLM apps on open models with fine-tuning needs

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference platform focused on fast, low-latency serving of open and custom models for production.
platforms.model_count: 100+ curated open models plus custom-deployed models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; on-demand dedicated GPU deployments billed hourly; fine-tuning available
features: Function calling and structured output (JSON mode)
LoRA fine-tuning and custom model hosting
platforms.best_for: Production teams prioritizing speed, latency, and reliability for open-model inference at scale

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer inference cloud offering cost-effective API access to a wide range of open-source LLMs and multimodal models, popular in the China/Asia market.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Llama, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with aggressively low pricing; free quotas for some models; dedicated deployments available
features: Strong support for Chinese open models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM)
Text, image, audio, and video generation endpoints
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) seeking low-cost access to Chinese and global open models via a unified API

platforms.name: DeepInfra
platforms.purpose: A serverless inference platform serving open-source models through a simple, low-cost pay-per-use API.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models across text, image, audio, and embeddings
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token / per-use with low published rates; dedicated GPU options available
platforms.best_for: Cost-sensitive developers wanting cheap, no-ops access to popular open models

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform using custom LPU hardware to serve open models at very high token throughput.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mixtral, Whisper, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with competitive rates; free developer tier; enterprise GroqCloud plans
features: LPU-based hardware for extremely fast token generation
Very low latency for real-time applications
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-critical, real-time applications on open models
